_verificationNote: AUDITED 2026-08-15 — VALUES CONFIRMED CORRECT, no change needed. Applies to: TAX YEAR 2026 / COVERAGE YEAR 2026. Every band boundary and basis-point value below matches Rev. Proc. 2025-25 §3.01 exactly, read verbatim from https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/rp-25-25.pdf on 2026-08-15. The sibling 'verificationNote' key predates this audit and is now stale: these are not placeholders. Also confirmed by the same document: the 2026 Required Contribution Percentage (§36B(c)(2)(C)(i)(II) employer-coverage affordability) is 9.96% — not encoded here because the engine does not yet model employer coverage. The top band terminating at 400% is the 400% cliff: for 2026 the ARPA/IRA enhancement has expired and there is no applicable percentage above 400% FPL. WHERE TO RE-CHECK ANNUALLY: the IRS publishes the §36B indexing revenue procedure around July–August for the following calendar year, at https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/rp-YY-NN.pdf . Extract the PDF text and read the table directly; do not trust a summarizer, which during this audit fabricated an entirely different table. Also watch govinfo PLAW-* for legislation amending §36B(b)(3)(A). See VERIFICATION-STATUS.md.

note: Bands are 'at least fromPct but less than toPct' except the final band, which includes 400 exactly. Within a band the applicable percentage is linearly interpolated on the truncated whole-percent FPL figure, then rounded to the nearest hundredth of a percent (whole basis point), matching the Form 8962 applicable-figure method.

eligibilityCeiling.note: The 400% ceiling of IRC §36B(c)(1)(A), encoded the way Form 8962 Worksheet 2 actually applies it. Step 4 asks FIRST whether household income is MORE THAN the poverty line × ceilingMultipleBps (4.0). If yes, you enter ineligibleSentinelPct (401) on line 5 and stop — the whole-percent truncation is reached only in the 'No' branch. Consequence, and the reason this is data and not a constant: there is NO sub-1% grace band above 400%. Income of 400.9% of FPL is 401, not 400. The last eligible MAGI is exactly 4.0 × the poverty line, not ceil(401 × FPL / 100) − 1. Truncation still governs every INTERIOR boundary (133, 150, 200, 250, 300 and the 250% CSR ledge) — only the ceiling is a strict multiple test. A future year that restores a phase-out above 400% (as ARPA/IRA did for 2021–2025) changes this ceiling: express it in a NEW dated ruleset rather than editing this one.
